integrity: Every claimed all-length identity has a direct finite combinatorial proof. Finite exact enumeration corroborates the proof but is not a substitute for it. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact single-symbol deletion output distribution for a fixed q-ary de Bruijn circle with q>=2,n>=2; excludes reflection, alphabet permutation, two deletions, noisy reads, unknown-source decoding and code-capacity claims. Priority may be affected by unindexed cyclic-deletion literature.
title: An invariant one-deletion trace spectrum for every de Bruijn cycle
